method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 48, compilation date 1 July 2026 (amendments to Act No. 57, 2025), register id C2026C00294; Paid Parental Leave Rules 2021, Compilation No. 7, compilation date 27 September 2025 (amendments to F2025L01195), register id F2025C00942, deposited and used (ss 7B, 9, 21, 22, 23, 24B, 36); national minimum wage, indexed income limits after 2021/2024 and the SG charge percentage are inputs
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under CC BY 4.0 with the attribution in ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 11D, 13(2)(b), (d), (3), 15, 21, 31A, 31AA(2), (4), 31AB(2), (3), (8), 31ABA, 32-36AA, 37, 39-41, 45, 46, 54, 57A(2), 59A, 60, 65, 67-74, 80, 84(2), (2A), 99, 101, 115B, 115C; PPL rules ss 7B, 9, 21, 22, 23, 24B, 36 -- who may claim and the birth mother's permission, flexible PPL days, the child's total and the partnered claimant's limit (reserved days), days paid to both parents at once, eligibility on a day, the work test (incl. the self-employed and special circumstances), the income test, residency and the waiting period, when to claim, the daily rate and instalment, employer determinations and who pays, the paymaster's duties, and the PPL superannuation contribution
seat: the parent (birth mother, or her partner or the child's other parent; employee or self-employed)
